You who look to God for peace with all your heart
The Lord who made heaven and earth, all things, and us
How deeply He loves you
You who worship and praise God with all your heart
You who long with all your heart to become more like God
The Lord who made heaven and earth, all things, and us
He welcomes you as a child of God
With His loving eyes, God

In His kindness, God listens
He hears you wherever and whenever you call
His light shines on you in the darkness
He listens closely even to the faintest voice

Look to the Lord alone

For this,
